sections.heading: Completed course still shows as incomplete
sections.text: Course completions from the learning portal are copied to user profiles overnight. A course completed today normally appears as complete the next morning. Required training must show as complete before study access is activated.

steps.text: Record the course name and the date and time the user completed it.
Share this article section explaining the overnight update.

information_needed.prompt: The course name as shown in the learning portal.

stop_conditions.text: If a completion is still missing two business days after completion, stop and escalate to the training administrator.
